arguments.text: 6000 m, 1250 m out-and-back legs. Goal: even effort near pod CP (168 W shaft, sustainable ~177 W) so pod reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) reaches ~0.1 only in the last 400-500 m, then finish sprint. Let the hard start settle by min 2-3; if shaft power stays >190 W after min 3, cue ease. Treat boat-speed-derived reserve with care (current/wind). Watch for sudden speed loss at same pod power (weed on rudder, drag) and instrument drift (pod vs boat-model power disagreement). Finish cue at ~400 m to go.

arguments.text: Min 18.5: held 181-186 W 2.5 min past pod-model empty, no collapse: set cp_shaft 175 (was 168), cp_w 111 (was 106); recomputed pod reserve 35%, boat 18%. This correction is a moderate guess (true CP/reserve unknown, min consistent was CP ~170 or W ~19.5 kJ). Plan for finish: hold ~182-185 W after the last turn (against current), finish sprint at ~450 m; if shaft drops sharply below 175 W without a cue, the reserve really was empty: do not push, reassure, sprint only last 200 m.
